title: Canceling stamps: Floor ticket
summary: Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
Matching cancellation stamps erase each other when they meet at the top of the paper pile. Ada is checking the lower stop before the ribbon press opens. A negative reading is a real measurement and must not be replaced by an invented zero.

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top.

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement cancelingStampsFloorTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Stack cancellation. Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with stack cancellation. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,-3,7,0,12]. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives -3.
The derived sequence is [-2,4]. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives -2.
The derived sequence is []. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.
